title: Kaynes Technology Q2 FY27: net profit ₹39.8 crore vs ₹115.7 crore a year ago #Shorts
description:
Kaynes Technology reported a consolidated net profit of ₹39.8 crore for Q2 FY27, compared with ₹115.7 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous year, per Business Standard.
